mapper.sql: id, title, description, category, price, item_condition, trade_location, delivery_options, publish_time, seller_name, contact, status, image_url, created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE items SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, price = #{price}, item_condition = #{itemCondition}, trade_location = #{tradeLocation}, delivery_options = #{deliveryOptions}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, seller_name = #{sellerName}, contact = #{contact}, status = #{status}, image_url = #{imageUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE status = #{status}
